vo.en: Cross your fingers just like this.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hands crossing his middle finger over his index finger in a slow, deliberate motion.

vo.en: Put your middle finger right over your index finger and hold them tight together.

visual.description: Macro shot of fingers overlapping with high detail on skin texture and grip.

vo.en: Now close your eyes and rub the very tip of your nose using the gap between your fingers.

visual.description: A man with his eyes closed touching the tip of his nose with his crossed fingers.

vo.en: Wait until you feel this part, because your brain is about to glitch out completely.

visual.description: Abstract digital glitch overlaying a dark background with pulsing yellow highlights.

vo.en: Your nerves are screaming that there are two separate noses under your touch, even though you know better.

visual.description: A man looking into the camera with a shocked and confused facial expression.

vo.en: This Aristotle Illusion happens because your sensory map fails to account for your crossed finger positions.

visual.description: Animation of neural pathways or a blue circuit board lighting up in patterns.

vo.en: Subscribe for more brain hacks and comment GLITCH if this worked on you, which is exactly why...
